issues.what: Siraj's curse drifts: brother in ch2-3 becomes a cousin in ch5-6; the outburst moves from the feeding ground to the market; Chaltu blamed though she was fed both nights
issues.quote: He had shouted his envy of his cousin into the market air

issues.what: Siraj's grudge retold as a loan and a wedding cow, contradicting ch2's shorted shop and lying scale
issues.quote: He had shouted at his cousin about a loan and a wedding cow

issues.what: Mesfin's confession changes each time: told her to take the car vs wait for the bus (ch3), checked brakes (ch5) vs did not check her car (ch6); his joke becomes 'tired of forms'
issues.quote: I did not check her car that month. I told the meat, as a joke, that I was tired of forms.

issues.what: Wub's line contradicts itself within one sentence
issues.quote: I told you to wait for the bus, forgive me, I told you to take the car

issues.what: Meta text in prose
issues.quote: humming on the hills in Chapter 1

issues.what: Salted-strip count broken: 'whispered three times', 'tomorrow is the last', yet two strips go to nights five and six; ch5 has the jar in Ikram's bucket and then in Yonis's sack
issues.quote: He whispered three times. One for each night he missed. Tomorrow is the last.

issues.what: Continuity: Abbas fed forty years (ch1), not twenty; Ikram refused the trade at seventeen, not sixteen; her shame fed 'eleven days' though she has fed six nights
issues.quote: This was the spot Abbas had stood for twenty years.

issues.what: The bite was near Fedis in ch1, Dire Dawa in ch5
issues.quote: One bite near Dire Dawa, not even Harar

issues.what: Timeline: father still 'dead eleven days' on the fourth night; 'eleven days' reused for others' grudges
issues.quote: Her father, dead eleven days in the ground near the wall

issues.what: Butcher named Dawit in ch1 is Siraj from ch2 on
issues.quote: The butcher Dawit came to me.

issues.what: Repeated phrases across chapters: swallows cutting lines above minarets, feet through grass like paper tearing, hairs lifting on arms, dog barked twice and stopped, yesterday's coffee, Oromo love song radio, 'messenger for a month and too proud'
issues.quote: Swallows cut lines above the minarets.

issues.what: Ch2 and ch3 end on the same beat: Wub laughs, Mesfin flinches
issues.quote: Mesfin flinched as if struck

issues.what: Generic or mismatched titles: 'The Second Feeding'; 'The Cull Order' sits on the confession chapter while the order is signed and torn in ch5
issues.quote: The Second Feeding

fix: Ch1: butcher Dawit -> Siraj. Ch2-6: keep Siraj's grudge as his brother and the shorted shop, shouted on the hill when his hyena missed. Ch3/5/6: one version of Mesfin's guilt (she said the pedal felt low, he told her to take the car). Ch4-5: strip count and jar location. Ch6: remove meta text, forty years, seventeen, first-night shame. De-duplicate phrases; retitle ch2-5.
praise: The magic is stated as plain local fact and pays off beautifully: Abbas's pride carried in salt by his rival, and a town that learns to say its own things aloud.

issues.what: The king's men buying the echoes is retold as if new, in the brief's own words
issues.quote: They rode through the land with sacks and gold, buying every echo from every cliff and well and valley.

issues.what: Brief planned-moment text pasted into Koman's dialogue, then the hunters and children scenes from ch2 recapped
issues.quote: the hunters are lost in the bush and the children forget their songs

issues.what: The children forget their song in ch1, then the same forgetting is staged as new in ch2
issues.quote: By the third singing they forgot the tune.

issues.what: Garbled sentence, and the echoes 'fall to powder' yet are revived at the river
issues.quote: The third jar cracked one by one with the others

issues.what: Two lost hunters in ch1 become three brothers in ch2
issues.quote: Two men walked three days in a circle

issues.what: The griot says he sang 'my praises', meaning the king's
issues.quote: I have sung my praises all my life

issues.what: Typo
issues.quote: Goats bells knocked

issues.what: 'There, there' was the echo's reply, not Nakani's whisper
issues.quote: Nakani’s whisper, There, there.

fix: Ch3: cut the paragraph re-narrating the echo-buying and the recap of the hunters and children, and replace Koman's brief-quote line with his own words; fix the garbled cracking sentence and let the starved echoes be weak, not powder. Ch1: three brothers; leave the children's forgetting to ch2; the king's praises. Ch2: typo.
praise: The griot voice holds all the way, and the echo answering the king with his own 'Pour' is a perfect folktale turn.
